answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh falcon challenge every epoch. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed summit of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. The vine is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal f4g30.
